title: Consideraciones arqueológicas y etnohistóricas sobre instalaciones camineras del Tawantinsuyu
lineage: Full article PDF retained. The cited relay passage is Cieza Second Part, chapter XXI; the study uses a 2005 edition marked [1553], while the first part alone was printed in 1553.
